decisions.story_title: Telerik UI AES-CBC Padding Oracle Chain Enables Unauthenticated RCE
decisions.reason: Critical vulnerability chain in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX (versions 2010.1.309 through 2026.2.519) allowing unauthenticated RCE via AES-CBC padding oracle. Widespread enterprise component, real vulnerability research by Tanto Security.

decisions.story_title: DPRK-Linked Actors Deploy Novel Linux Espionage Toolkit Against South Korean HAProxy Servers
decisions.reason: Previously undocumented Linux espionage toolkit targeting South Korean automotive and media sectors. Not a HAProxy vulnerability but abuse of legitimate access to backdoor edge servers.
